claim: Says how the foreground occluder behaves across the clip — held still, swaying, drifting, parallaxing, or passing clean through the lens. Something crossing in front of camera is the single strongest depth cue available in a generated shot.
not_visual: Same problem one plane forward: this is behaviour over time, not content. A still cannot separate a held branch from a swaying one, and pass_through is defined entirely by the element entering and leaving frame. The only thing a clause could render is smeared motion blur, which is a different variable. Belongs in a clip demo.
